request_scope.entity_selection: one authoritative entity URI selected by maintainer at execution time

execution_requirements: maintainer confirms credential custody outside Git
maintainer confirms WHO terms and local-only response handling
request and response timestamps are recorded
response is redacted or excluded before any commit
fail_closed_conditions: terms or rate limits cannot be documented
response contains prohibited payload beyond approved scope
foundation and MMS provenance cannot be separated
language or release metadata is absent
commit_policy: commit this manifest and derived validation summaries only; never commit credentials, tokens, full responses, labels, synonyms, definitions, or release rows
